cardinality.rule: getAllVolumeIds read: a viewport has no getAllVolumeIds in 6.0, so a test of it is always false: test viewport.getVolumeIds, which a planar viewport has in stack mode too (it gives [] there), or utilities.viewportIsInVolumeMode(viewport)

setZoom: the second argument storeAsInitialCamera is gone (6.0 reads a second argument of setZoom as the canvas point to zoom about): a next viewport has no stored initial camera, a reset goes back to the fit, so delete the argument and set the zoom or the pan again after resetViewState where the application went back to it
